feature1.hint_texts: Feature 1 covers the fix for simple tags. The implementation should focus on updating the conditional logic in the parse_bits function so that for simple tags the check correctly uses the set of keyword-only arguments (kwonly). Developers should ensure that when a simple tag is defined with a keyword-only argument with a default value, the tag can accept an override correctly, and that providing the same keyword argument twice produces an error reflecting multiple values.
feature1.entrypoint: File: django/template/library.py, function: parse_bits. Review the code block starting around line 261 where the condition is modified: replace the check using 'unhandled_kwargs' with one that uses 'kwonly'.

feature2.prompt: Custom template tags raise TemplateSyntaxError when keyword-only arguments with defaults are provided. Same goes for inclusion tags. When inclusion tags are used, they follow the same code path as simple tags and suffer from the same issue: the handling of keyword-only arguments with default values is incorrect. This results in errors when a keyword argument is supplied or when it is supplied more than once, leading to unexpected error messages.
feature2.hint_texts: Feature 2 focuses on the inclusion tags. Although inclusion tags share the underlying parsing logic with simple tags, the fix must ensure that inclusion tag usages handle keyword-only arguments correctly. The changes in the parse_bits function must also ensure that inclusion tags generate the correct error message when a keyword is provided more than once and allow default keyword values to be overridden properly.
feature2.entrypoint: File: django/template/library.py, function: parse_bits. Apply the same modification here, ensuring that the 'kwonly' keyword set is used for inclusion tag scenarios. Also, review integration with inclusion tag registration in the code to ensure consistency.

collaboration_points.shared_resources: The key shared resource is the django/template/library.py file, specifically the parse_bits function and the handling of the 'kwonly' logic.
collaboration_points.integration_strategy: Both features modify the same underlying parsing logic. The simple tags fix and the inclusion tags fix should be implemented such that changes in parse_bits work uniformly for both. Each feature should have its independent tests, but final integration requires verifying that the shared change meets the requirements for both simple and inclusion tags.
collaboration_points.communication_needs: Developers working on feature1 and feature2 need to coordinate on the changes to the shared parse_bits logic. They should discuss the introduction and use of the 'kwonly' parameter, agree on the error messaging format for both cases, and ensure that their respective tests cover all relevant scenarios.
